title: Alaska Air Group enters activation phase of Alaska Accelerate, building a more global, premium and diversified airline
summary: The next phase of Alaska Accelerate, Alaska Air Group’s long-term growth strategy, includes new flagship premium experiences for Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines, a new Premium Reserve cabin, new lounges, expanded Atmos™ Rewards financial products, at least 15 long-haul intercontinental destinations by 2030, a larger cargo platform and continued investment in Hawaiian’s Kahuʻewai Hawaiʻi Investment Plan.
